dependencies: NC-055 benchmark definitions as read-only design input
hypothesis: Lowest prefix-supported symbolic description may extrapolate better than fixed controls within equal allocated budgets; NO_GAIN remains valid.
limitations: Unknown processes are not proven by finite prefix fit. No global minimality, general intelligence, neural discovery, RSI gain, or champion promotion.
Same candidate and CPU ceilings are allocated; consumed work differs. Fitting time counts in CPU, unsuccessful fitting attempts do not count as candidate verification calls.

Candidate and evaluator developed by one implementer; pending independent audit and fresh-secret-seed replication. Seed disclosure after run permits future replay but does not make implementer an independent reviewer.
Open grammar and generator families are known; fresh parameters, seeds, lengths and perturbations are unseen by participant, not necessarily unseen concepts.
Conservative structural signatures can reject observationally equivalent AR/periodic descriptions; forecast and recovery metrics are separate.
Noisy observations, future switching, aliased sampling and chaotic long horizons may fail. Report every failure and actual costs.
Cooperative per-arm CPU checks can overshoot during one bounded fitting/check operation; process CPU/memory/wall limits are hard.
minimality: best found within explicitly enumerated grammar and checked budget only; no globally minimal-law certificate
precision: exact rational strings; Decimal90 logistic target; float forecast abs1e-6+rel1e-8 plus exact-equality report
